item.title: At least 33 wounded, two in moderate condition, after projectile hits home in northern Israel
item.summary: The strike hit a residential building in Zarzir near Nazareth after three waves of launches from Iran triggered widespread air raid sirens across northern Israel within about an hour

item.summary: As the security cabinet discusses expanding operations in Lebanon, a senior official said Hezbollah planned to fire about 600 rockets in last night’s barrage but launched only around 200; the Washington Post reported Israel rejected a Lebanese ceasefire proposal that included ...

item.summary: After targeting Iran’s nuclear and missile programs, Israel has intensified strikes in Tehran aimed at the regime’s repression apparatus, including the Basij militia — a force of millions blamed for crushing protests; Israel claims significant damage and hopes it could fuel in...

item.title: Katz threatens to seize Lebanon land if Hezbollah fire persists
item.summary: Defense minister says military preparing to expand operations in Lebanon and warns that if Beirut fails to stop Hezbollah attacks on northern Israel, Israeli forces will take territory to restore security

item.title: Iran missiles trigger sirens across greater Jerusalem, all intercepted
item.summary: Air defenses intercept missiles launched toward greater Jerusalem, the Shfela and the Jordan Valley on Thursday morning, with no injuries reported, as emergency teams check reports of a road impact near Har Gilo and interceptor debris in Mamilla

item.title: Israel says cracks forming in Iran’s military chain of command
item.summary: After almost two weeks of war, officials say Iran’s forces are showing weaker coordination, lower motivation and sharply reduced launch rates, even as the Israeli Air Force expands strikes on military industries, missile launchers and Basij headquarters

item.title: ‘If a nuclear Iran took the Strait of Hormuz, who would control the world’s oil?’
item.summary: Israeli Ambassador to the United States Yechiel Leiter argues the US-Israeli campaign aims to stop Tehran from acquiring nuclear weapons, exporting terrorism and gaining leverage over global energy routes

item.title: Israel shifts to Gaza-style defense in Lebanon as IDF pushes fight beyond border to protect northern towns
item.summary: Reservists operating inside southern Lebanon say the goal is to keep Hezbollah threats away from Israeli communities by pushing the front line deeper into enemy territory as the military prepares for a prolonged campaign

item.title: How Israel lost the element of surprise against Hezbollah as war with Iran reshaped the battlefield
item.summary: IDF had prepared a surprise strike against Hezbollah leadership and rocket units, but political delays and the war with Iran shifted resources and cost Israel the element of surprise as tensions along the Lebanon border escalate
